measurement.cardModel: index-connected components; root band is the nearest ceil(component vertices / 2) to the closure-defined region union
measurement.lidRegion: raw glTF y-up (axis 1 required): raw card class is root-band centroid above/below the matching connected eye-shell centroid; upper region is triangles with at least one moving vertex and centroid above eye centroid; lower region is unchanged; exact same own-region triangle seats and follows
measurement.g2: point-to-triangle root-anchor gaps at closure weights 0 and 1 against both deformed own-region triangles and the general body surface intersecting the lash-local 20 mm proof AABB
measurement.g1: form points (horizontal-axis x, abs(dy)) from moving upper-lid body vertices (abs(dy)>1e-6m, above eye centroid); take the monotone-chain upper convex hull and linearly interpolate its magnitude at each card root-centroid x, with sign from hull vertex dy; outside hull span is no_margin; measurable-card p50 is the true median (average middle pair for even N), p10/p90 retain lower-index percentile behavior; upper median must be 80..120 and every measurable card same-direction; with the hull as margin, the upper bound mainly guards the x2 closure probe and an overshooting target; lower cards are report-only
measurement.physicianExclusion: mpfb-clinical-physician-adult L/R measured and reported but excluded from G1 tally (2 sides, 54 F4 cards) pending tsk_5427053465726368 because closure 1 folds the body lids into the socket
measurement.f4: >4.55 mm is report-only: card remains at original position with zero closure delta; unreviewed flags fail acceptance
measurement.inside: odd ray parity per connected eye shell; per-card origin/main at both weights is the baseline and patched counts must not increase
measurement.counterweights: sha256 over semantic/type/component/count-framed accessor bytes per primitive; every named body target semantic is compared to origin/main
